_doc: Per-language filler words/phrases removed by tighten.py's automated pass (long-form world). Curated, NOT model-chosen — reproducible and inspectable. Matching is case-insensitive, punctuation-stripped; a multi-word entry matches a consecutive run of words. Keep it CONSERVATIVE: only tokens that are almost never real content. `tighten.py` prints every proposed cut in context so the agent + user review before `apply`; hand-drop anything the list misses per project rather than adding an ambiguous word here.
